assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single transparent full-body fighting-game sprite for Resident Evil Combat. Transform the supplied reference of Parker Luciani into a polished semi-realistic painted 2D sprite. Identity and costume are the BSAA Queen Zenobia infiltration wetsuit from Resident Evil Revelations HD/Unveiled Edition (2013), NOT the separate Raid BSAA uniform and NOT the FBC costume. The supplied full-body official character render is the visual reference; second Steam card corroborates HD face and torso. Preserve Parker's broad stocky realistic adult proportions, thick neck, brown medium length slightly wavy hair parted off-centre, short brown beard, compact heavy torso. Preserve the dark charcoal wetsuit, teal desaturated load-bearing vest with four front lower rectangular pouches and orange-brown closure tabs, two light grey buoyancy panels on upper chest, brown leather forearm and lower-shin reinforcements, dark hiking/diving boots, grey crotch harness and double thigh straps, original left-chest breathing hose/gauge assembly, original thigh equipment and yellow-handled knife on his LEFT outer shin. Do not swap asymmetric gear when he turns. His wood-stock pump shotgun from the reference is held in a low ready two-handed position, not fired, muzzle slightly downward. Keep plausible two hands, five fingers, two legs; one continuous firearm. Camera near side-view, mild three-quarter angle appropriate to 2D fighting; full head-to-sole body and full weapon visible, all elements at least 10% from the image borders. Feet on a consistent invisible baseline. Readable silhouette, detailed fabric, metal and leather, painted 2D game art, no vector style, no pixel art, no photography. A single person and a single pose only. True transparent RGBA background; no scene, floor, contact shadow, logo, text, border, watermark or sheet. Aim for a 2048 by 2048 square asset. Neutral soft illumination, no dramatic colored rim light. Direction: Parker's face, gaze, torso and the shotgun muzzle must point to image LEFT. A restrained combat-ready stance with knees slightly flexed; don't draw a frontal portrait.
